extracted.intended_audience: general public, media, policymakers, donors, scholars
extracted.subtask_description: Organizational/about page describing the American Enterprise Institute's mission, governance, research standards, topical priorities, reporting practices, and press contact procedures.

rubrics_metrics.name: Highest standards of integrity, intellectual rigor, and excellence
rubrics_metrics.description: AEI trustees, scholars and fellows, and officers and staff are responsible for maintaining the highest standards of integrity, intellectual rigor and excellence.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Statement frames AEI's baseline expectation for all work produced by the institute; implies adherence to ethical behavior, careful reasoning, and high-quality outputs across activities.

rubrics_metrics.name: Founding commitments: open inquiry, lucid exposition, vigorous debate, continuous improvement
rubrics_metrics.description: Sustaining AEI’s founding commitment to open inquiry, lucid exposition, vigorous debate and continuous improvement in the institutions of American liberty.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: These four values guide how scholarship and public engagement should be conducted — encouraging transparent questioning, clear writing, robust exchange of ideas, and iterative institutional improvement.

rubrics_metrics.name: Independent, empirical research
rubrics_metrics.description: Leading scholars conduct independent, empirical research aimed at strengthening free enterprise, expanding opportunity, and safeguarding America’s role in the world.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Emphasizes methodological independence and empirical (data-driven) approaches as hallmarks of acceptable research at AEI; research should seek to be evidence-based rather than purely advocacy-driven.

rubrics_metrics.name: Evidence-based policy solutions
rubrics_metrics.description: Domestic Policy Studies develops evidence-based solutions to America’s key internal challenges.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Policy proposals and recommendations should be grounded in data and empirical analysis; interdisciplinary expert collaboration is encouraged to produce these solutions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Interdisciplinary insight
rubrics_metrics.description: AEI’s research structure brings together scholars across areas to address complex challenges with interdisciplinary insight.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Work should draw from multiple disciplines as needed to address policy complexity rather than remaining siloed within a single field.

rubrics_metrics.name: Mission-aligned values (democracy, free enterprise, American strength, solidarity, pluralistic entrepreneurial culture)
rubrics_metrics.description: The work of AEI scholars advances ideas rooted in belief in democracy, free enterprise, American strength and global leadership, solidarity with those at the periphery of our society, and a pluralistic, entrepreneurial culture.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This describes the normative frame and priorities that should inform AEI scholarship and communications; submissions and projects are expected to align with or engage these values.

rubrics_metrics.name: Annual reporting: transparency and honest assessment
rubrics_metrics.description: AEI’s annual report serves as a report card—highlighting significant activity from our scholars, showing where we’ve had success, and being honest about where we need to do better.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Institutional reporting should document accomplishments and candidly acknowledge shortcomings; the annual report is a vehicle for accountability and tracking progress on priorities.

rubrics_metrics.name: Economics research topical focus
rubrics_metrics.description: AEI Economic Policy scholars research U.S. and global economic issues ... focusing on growth, jobs, inflation, trade, taxes, poverty, and financial systems.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Specifies core topic areas that AEI economics work emphasizes; proposals and research in economics should relate to these substantive areas.

rubrics_metrics.name: Foreign and defense policy focus
rubrics_metrics.description: Foreign and defense policy scholars promote U.S. global leadership to ensure peace and freedom, studying defense, terrorism, economic statecraft, and key regions like China, Russia, the Middle East, and more.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Research and commentary in this area should address national security, geopolitics, and region-specific issues aligned with promoting U.S. leadership.

rubrics_metrics.name: Social, Cultural, and Constitutional Studies scope
rubrics_metrics.description: SCCS scholars study law, politics, and culture—covering the Constitution, courts, Congress, elections, public opinion, education, civil society, media, religion, and American history.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Defines the substantive scope for scholarship in SCCS; acceptable work should engage one or more of these topics.

rubrics_metrics.name: Domestic Policy Studies scope
rubrics_metrics.description: Domestic Policy Studies brings together experts across health care, education, housing, welfare, and more to develop solutions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Indicates the policy domains and cross-expert collaboration expected for domestic-focused work.

rubrics_metrics.name: Governance by a Board of Trustees of business and financial executives
rubrics_metrics.description: The American Enterprise Institute is governed by a Board of Trustees, composed of leading business and financial executives.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Describes AEI's governance structure and the stakeholder background expected to oversee institutional direction; implies accountability to trustees with private-sector expertise.

rubrics_metrics.name: Press inquiry procedure
rubrics_metrics.description: Press Inquiries: Press Department. Press Email: [email protected]. Press Phone: 202.862.5829.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Media requests and communications about AEI should be routed to the designated press department via the provided contact information; this is the procedural requirement for press engagement.
